incidence_equations.legal: L_S(z) iff z is not selected and det(a,b,z) != 0 for every distinct selected a,b
incidence_equations.omega_zero: there is no zero-load line ell containing three distinct points of L_S
incidence_equations.outer_relation: R_small(T;o,p) iff p in L_{T+o} and T+o+p satisfies the small boundary or small shell
incidence_equations.small_boundary: Omega(S)=0 and either L_S is empty or L_S={a,b} with L_{S+a}(b)
incidence_equations.small_shell: for every x in L_S there exists y in L_{S+x} such that S+x+y satisfies the small boundary
